values.note: All sites $20 a night; stay 5 nights, the 6th consecutive night is free. Cash (preferred) or check on arrival.

fees.source: http://www.chalkhillscampground.com/CampgroundInfo.aspx ('ALL SITES ARE $20 PER NIGHT', 'stay 5 nights, get 6th consecutive night FREE'), http://www.chalkhillscampground.com/ ('At only $20 per night for a site with electricity', beside 'OPENING MAY 1st for 2026'), read 2026-10-22

note: Small family-run campground in one wooded loop near the Chalk Hills Dam on the Menominee River (UP, Michigan side); large pads, most sites 50-75 ft apart. Self-registration envelopes at the well house; no change given. The well-house drinking water can't be used to fill camper tanks. A short trail over WE Energies land (open to the public) reaches the river; two boat launches within 5 miles. --Claude
summary: Operator site (now reachable) confirms 25 sites, 30/50 amp, 7 pull-thrus, $20/night (6th night free), opening May 1 2026, free phone/email reservations that are optional, 30-day stay cap. Corrected: water hook-up true -> false (drinking water only at the well house, not for tanks) and no dump station recorded.
